scope: Frozen calibration-only candidate mapping, held-out timing observations within one already reused PSS-780 recording.

protocol.status: frozen before new onset audio measurement
protocol.purpose: Held-out audible-event timing validation within one already reused hardware recording; not an independent recording or chip-clock identification.

old_alignment.method: Globally whitened 12-bin STFT chroma; fixed harmonic MIDI chroma; global affine grid/differential evolution, no local warping.
caveats: Approximate chroma onset alignment depends on patch attack.
MIDI file identity is supported by description and global pitch progression; sender settings and channel routing remain unknown.
All source MIDI velocities are127; this does not independently verify hardware velocity processing.

protocol.calibration_rule: Aggregate simultaneous notes by median residual first; then summarize each calibration patch by median unique-onset MIDI time and median unique-onset residual. Summary audible time=oldOffset+oldScale*medianTime+medianResidual. Four patch summaries have equal weight.

candidate_fit_rules.old_scale_median_offset: Retain old scale; add median of four patch-summary residuals to old offset.
candidate_fit_rules.equal_patch_robust_affine: Scale=median of six pairwise slopes among four patch-summary(time,audibleTime) points; intercept=median of four(audibleTime-scale*time).

protocol.selection_rule: Fixed patches19/52/91/98; both operators rawAR63, modTL>=40, carrier sine, voiceVibratoOFF. MIDI>=72; at least.10s after inferred program boundary; at least.25s since previous same-pitch source MIDI off. Zero-case patches stay absent; no replacement training/validation cases.
protocol.measurement_rule: Exactly previous onset audit: arithmetic stereo mid, nominal carrier-frequency centered Hann demodulation12/24/48ms. Median beforeoldOn[-.12,-.07] and afteroldOn[+.07,+.11] define amplitude step; first crossing10/50/90% overoldOn[-.08,+.14], persist >threshold for >90% of next2ms samples. Primary24ms50% needs a crossing, after>before and after>=2*before. All failures retained. Candidate maps never change measurement windows.
protocol.evaluation_rule: Aggregate valid simultaneous-note primary residuals by median to one audible-onset group. For each map, groupResidual=measuredAudibleOn-(offset+scale*sourceMidiOn). Per-patch error=median(abs(groupResidual)); primary score=mean of per-patch errors with equal weight across usable validation patches. Report signed patch medians, extrema, every group, and12/48ms sensitivity separately.

acceptance_rule.unique_selection_explanation: A unique supported candidate must satisfy coverage, improve primary score>=20% vs unchanged, regress no patch by>5ms, and beat every other improved eligible candidate by>=3ms. Otherwise improved maps remain indistinguishable/provisional; no production map is adopted.

result.interpretation: Held-out timing observations within reused audio; no production map adopted, no chip-clock recovery claimed.

conclusion.cause_of_rejection: Each score reduction<20%, and each correction worsens JazzGuitar52 by~40-42ms. Local timing variation is not resolved by these global maps.

limitations: GlassCelesta19 has no eligible MIDI>=72 cases; no substitute was introduced.
Three usable validation patches span93-175s, with seven groups; coverage is sparse and patch/time confounded.
Vibraphone12ms measurements fail contrast and remain recorded.
Frequency-selective audible onsets are not delivered MIDI timestamps.
No physical OPU clock or chip latency is recovered.
next_use: Preserve exact fixed maps as labeled envelope-benchmark sensitivity conditions, with no per-window or DSP-specific timing optimization.
